title: JRE 2383 - Ian Edwards
guestBio: Ian Edwards is a comic, actor, and host of the "Soccer Comic Rant" podcast. Watch his new comedy special, "Ian Edwards: Untitled," now streaming on YouTube.
tldr: Ian Edwards discusses his comedy special 'Untitled' now streaming on YouTube and his evolution as a performer
Conversation covers the state of comedy today and how the industry has changed over Edwards' career
Ian talks about hosting the 'Soccer Comic Rant' podcast and his passion for soccer
Discussion about the challenges comedians face with cancel culture and changing audiences
Ian shares stories from his acting and hosting experiences in the entertainment industry
Joe and Ian explore what makes comedy work and the importance of authenticity on stage
recap:
Ian Edwards sits down with Joe on JRE 2383 to talk about his comedy career, his new special 'Untitled' available on YouTube, and his work as a host and actor in the entertainment industry. Edwards brings the energy of someone who's been grinding in comedy for years, and the conversation quickly gets into the real talk about what it takes to succeed as a stand-up in today's climate.

The episode explores how comedy has evolved and what audiences actually want to see. Edwards shares his perspective on performing, the importance of staying true to your material, and how comedians navigate an industry that's more scrutinized than ever. He talks about his experience hosting the 'Soccer Comic Rant' podcast, which showcases his passion for the sport beyond just comedy.

Joe and Ian get into the weeds about authenticity in stand-up, the relationship between a comedian and their audience, and what separates good comics from great ones. Edwards doesn't hold back about the challenges facing comedians today, including how social media and cancel culture have changed the landscape. The conversation touches on what it takes to build a sustainable career in comedy and how Edwards has managed to stay relevant and funny over the years.

Throughout the episode, Edwards demonstrates why he's respected in the comedy community. He's thoughtful about the craft while also being hilarious, and Joe clearly enjoys having someone who can talk shop about comedy at a deep level. The episode is a great look at the modern comedy scene from someone actively working in it.
